name: desktop
description: Fuji, a multimedia file manager, built with Tauri

scripts.icons: tauri icon src-tauri/icons/app-icon.svg && tauri icon src-tauri/icons/app-icon-mac.svg -o src-tauri/icons/.mac && tauri icon src-tauri/icons/app-icon-tile.svg -o src-tauri/icons/.tile && node -e "const f=require('fs');f.mkdirSync('src-tauri/icons/mac',{recursive:true});f.copyFileSync('src-tauri/icons/.mac/icon.icns','src-tauri/icons/mac/icon.icns');f.mkdirSync('src-tauri/icons/tile',{recursive:true});f.copyFileSync('src-tauri/icons/.tile/Square284x284Logo.png','src-tauri/icons/tile/tile-medium.png');f.copyFileSync('src-tauri/icons/.tile/Square142x142Logo.png','src-tauri/icons/tile/tile-small.png')"
